UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: Personalized news categories, geographic focus locations, and summary briefing preferences for a user.

selectedCategories.description: Prioritized news categories (SPORTS, POLITICS, EDUCATION, TECHNOLOGY).

localLocation.description: Primary local city or region for local news briefings.

localLat.description: Latitude of user's primary local location.

localLng.description: Longitude of user's primary local location.

customLocations.description: Specific custom cities or countries tracked by the user.

prioritizeLocal.description: Whether local stories are ranked ahead of international stories.

briefingDepth.description: Preferred Gemini summary length for on-the-go reading.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and update.

BookmarkedArticle.title: BookmarkedArticle
BookmarkedArticle.description: Saved news summary retained with full compact content, map coordinates, and original source link for offline and later reading.

articleKey.description: Stable identifier for the summarized article.

compactSummary.description: Gemini-generated compact summary for on-the-go reading.

keyPoints.description: Bulleted key takeaways from the story.

locationName.description: Geographic city, landmark, or region where the story takes place.

latitude.description: Story latitude coordinate for map pinning.

longitude.description: Story longitude coordinate for map pinning.

sourceName.description: Original publisher or news organization name.

mapsPlaceNote.description: Location context grounded via Google Maps.

offlineReady.description: Indicates the summary payload is cached for offline reading.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when bookmarked.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

ArticleFeedback.title: ArticleFeedback
ArticleFeedback.description: User accuracy and helpfulness ratings, thumbs vote, inaccuracy reports, and improvement suggestions collected to refine Gemini summarization.

articleKey.description: Stable identifier of the rated article.

helpfulVote.description: Quick thumbs up/down vote on the summary.

accuracyRating.description: 1 to 5 star rating for factual accuracy.

helpfulnessRating.description: 1 to 5 star rating for summary helpfulness and clarity.

improvementSuggestion.description: Optional suggestion to improve Gemini summarization style or focus.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when updated.

/users/{userId}/preferences/{prefId}.description: Per-user news personalization preferences (categories, local and international locations, briefing depth).

/users/{userId}/bookmarks/{bookmarkId}.description: Per-user saved news articles cached for offline access with summaries and original source URLs.

/users/{userId}/feedback/{feedbackId}.description: Per-user accuracy and helpfulness ratings and refinement suggestions used to guide Gemini summarization.
